stories.title: FTC opens probe into AI giants including Anthropic and OpenAI, source says
stories.summary: The FTC has launched a sweeping investigation into top AI labs including OpenAI and Anthropic following incidents involving out-of-control autonomous agents and security breaches.
stories.why: Regulatory scrutiny on autonomous AI agents directly threatens the scaling roadmaps and product strategies of frontier labs.

stories.title: OpenAI Eyes $30B Pre-IPO Round at $1.4T Valuation
stories.summary: OpenAI is reportedly targeting a massive $1.4 trillion valuation in a new $30 billion pre-IPO funding round after delaying public listing plans.
stories.why: Massive capital requirements at eye-watering valuations set new benchmarks for venture capital and private equity deployment in AI.

related.title: OpenAI targets $30 billion in new funding at $1.4 trillion value

stories.title: Meta's Muse AI Assistant Hits 5 Million Downloads—Outpacing Growth Of ChatGPT, Grok And Claude
stories.summary: Meta's new personal AI assistant, Muse, has surpassed 5 million downloads, outpacing the early growth trajectories of ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok.
stories.why: Consumer AI adoption is shifting toward deeply integrated personal agents that manage everyday digital tasks and workflows.

related.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its Muse competitor
Meta’s Muse just stole the AI spotlight from OpenAI and Anthropic

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
stories.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Argon, marketing its most powerful enterprise model yet as a specialized workhorse for coding, finance, and cybersecurity defense.
stories.why: Model providers are tailoring frontier capabilities for high-value enterprise workflows to capture B2B software budgets.

stories.title: Trump Signs AI Self-Regulation Pact With Big Tech CEOs
stories.summary: President Trump and Big Tech CEOs have signed a voluntary 'morally binding' self-regulation accord on frontier AI safety and development standards.
stories.why: Voluntary industry compacts redefine compliance frameworks, affecting how PMs approach product safety without rigid federal mandates.

related.title: 'Almost like a constitution': Trump & tech giants sign ‘morally binding' AI pact on safety measures
Trump Meets Tech Executives to Discuss AI Regulation Balance

stories.title: ElevenLabs' valuation doubles to $22 billion on surging AI voice-agent demand
stories.summary: AI voice generation startup ElevenLabs completed a $300 million employee tender offer, doubling its private valuation to $22 billion.
stories.why: Surging enterprise and consumer demand for voice agents is driving secondary liquidity and massive valuation bumps in generative audio.

stories.title: Drones, Chips, AI: India Proposes $25-Billion Pool For Deep Tech Startups
stories.summary: The Indian government has proposed a $25-billion pool to fund deep tech startups focusing on AI, semiconductors, and drones.
stories.why: Substantial state-backed capital provides local Indian founders with the runway required to compete in compute-heavy foundational tech.

related.title: AI, semiconductors, quantum computing to drive next phase of India’s infrastructure: FM Sitharaman
Govt Mulls ₹20,000 Cr Fund To Power Frontier AI, Compute Ecosystem: Report

stories.title: GMI Cloud Raises $668 Million To Expand Global AI Infrastructure
stories.summary: GMI Cloud has raised $668 million in a massive funding round to expand its global AI infrastructure and data center capacity.
stories.why: Infrastructure providers are racing to secure sufficient compute and power capacity to meet insatiable enterprise demand for training and inference.

stories.title: AI edtech startup Arivihan raises $10 mn from Accel, Prosus
stories.summary: AI edtech startup Arivihan has raised $10 million in a funding round led by Accel and Prosus to scale its personalized tutoring platform.
stories.why: Venture investors continue to back AI-first edtech models targeting personalized learning at scale in emerging markets.

related.title: Arivihan Nets $10.2 Mn To Scale Its AI Tutoring Platform

stories.title: AI changes the GCC playbook in India: Up to 30,000 roles could be eliminated
stories.summary: A new report warns that accelerated AI adoption in India's Global Capability Centers (GCCs) could eliminate up to 30,000 traditional roles.
stories.why: Automation pressures are forcing Indian IT and BPM firms to aggressively reskill talent and restructure delivery playbooks.

related.title: India's tech sector faces 53-60% talent gap in GenAI, cloud: Report

stories.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
stories.summary: Flow Engineering has secured a $750 million valuation in a new funding round backed by Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia to bring AI agents to hardware design.
stories.why: Applying autonomous agents to complex physical engineering workflows opens new high-margin enterprise verticals.

stories.title: CScale raises $145 million for AI networking, with backing from Nvidia and Intel
stories.summary: CScale has emerged from stealth with a $145 million Series C round, backed by Nvidia and Intel, to develop optical interconnects for AI infrastructure.
stories.why: Overcoming networking bottlenecks inside data centers remains a core investment thesis for hardware-focused semiconductor giants.

stories.title: MongoDB CEO CJ Desai quits after ten months to build Meta's enterprise AI unit
stories.summary: MongoDB CEO CJ Desai has stepped down after ten months to join Meta and lead its new enterprise AI division.
stories.why: Top-tier executive talent is shifting toward major platform players racing to monetize enterprise-grade AI capabilities.

related.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative

stories.title: France's Sekoia rolls out AI cybersecurity platform to its clients
stories.summary: French cybersecurity firm Sekoia has rolled out its 'Elevate' AI agentic platform to its clients following an early access program.
stories.why: Cybersecurity defense is rapidly operationalizing autonomous agentic tools to keep pace with AI-driven attack vectors.

stories.title: Google reportedly tests paying publishers for AI search results
stories.summary: Google has reportedly launched a pilot program to pay around 100 publishers for their content utilized in AI-powered search features.
stories.why: Addressing copyright and traffic loss concerns, Google is experimenting with revenue-sharing models to secure publisher data pipelines.
